messages.text: For a Aerospace / Defense use case involving radar, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow?

Short answer: In an Aerospace / Defense radar workflow, the passages do **not** support using a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester as the radar test instrument; it would fit only in the **wireless communications portion** of the workflow, such as LTE / 5G / WLAN link, OTA, RF, application, pre-conformance, or non-signaling RF validation around the platform or payload. [1][4][52]
- A signaling tester such as R&S CMX500 is positioned as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement solution for device testing across LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD. [1]
- In callbox use, CMX500 is used to quickly establish a DUT connection and run RF, mobility, application, NTN, WLAN / cellular desense, pre-conformance and non-signaling R&D verification. [4]
- The CMX500 callbox workflow explicitly includes Go-NoGo Testing, Non-Sig Testing, Conformance Testing and R&D Testing as test-phase context. [65]
- For signaling workflow, CMX500 provides NR FR1 / FR2 signaling, LTE signaling, NB-IoT / NB-NTN signaling, WLAN signaling and related TX measurements. [1]
- For non-signaling workflow, CMX500 GPRF Generator is described as a non-signaling use case that generates ARB, CW, dual tone or replay `.wv` waveforms for R&D waveform replay / creation and standalone TX measurement workflows. [54]
- For OTA communications testing, CMX500 OBT can be integrated with MVG WaveStudio and MVG antenna / multi-probe measurement systems to run 5G NR, RedCap, LTE and WLAN OTA signaling tests. [87]
- For radar-specific testing, the passages only identify R&S AREG800A as an Automotive Radar Echo Generator with dynamic artificial object generation, not as an Aerospace / Defense radar tester. [36]
- For Aerospace / Defense drone / UAV EMC and EME workflows, the cited solution focuses on EMI, EMS, EME, radiated / conducted layout and system-level effects testing, not cellular / WLAN protocol testing. [48]
- The same drone solution lists standard systems such as R&S TS9975 EMI Test System and R&S TS9982 EMS Test System for UAV / UAS drone T&M, but it does not map CMX500 to radar testing. [50]
- 【推論】Place the Signaling / Non-signaling Tester after or alongside radar/EME/EMC testing when the A&D system also needs LTE / 5G / WLAN connectivity validation, because CMX500 covers signaling and non-signaling communications tests while the A&D drone sources separate EMC / EME testing from signaling testing. [1][48][54]
- 【推論】Do not position CMX500 as the primary radar target/echo instrument from these passages; radar echo generation is only supported here for AREG800A in an automotive radar context, while CMX500 is supported for communications signaling and non-signaling RF workflows. [1][36][54]

passages.text:
R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › toolchain
來源列出的 CMX500 toolchain 包含：

- [[R&S CMsquares]]。
- [[R&S CONTEST]]。
- Conformance：LTE、NR、2G、3G、C-IoT。
- 測試範圍：RF Conformance、RRM、LBS、NetOp、PCT、signaling tests、application、callbox、NPT、PQA、3GPP RF preconformance、ATE。
- 相關設備：[[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S ATS CATR]]、[[R&S NGM200]]、[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing
[[CMX500 use-case based 5G testing]] 是 [[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]] 中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 market / solution positioning：以 use-case based approach 支援 5G eMBB、FWA、RedCap、NTN、XR 等裝置測試，而不只是一組單點工具。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › Shuffler
來源描述 [[Shuffler]]：

- RF / T-put test on all supported UE band combos in one go。
- All Shuffler tests part of [[R&S CMX-KF612M]] test package。
- Loop blocks provide flexibility to loop through bands、bandwidth、channels。
- one test script with one test report can test RF TX / RX measurement、RX sensitivity measurement、throughput、VoLTE / VoNR。
- Band combinations input via UE capabilities or user-defined Excel sheet。
- Shuffler implemented in [[R&S CMsequencer]]。

此處仍需正式 [[R&S CMX-KF612M]] 文件補證。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

2025RS Drone Solution › 與既有知識的關係
- [[UAV Technologies 外部資料清單]] 已保存 [[6. UAV Technologies]] 中 UAV regulation、standards、PDF 與 link hub 線索；本來源比 [[6. UAV Technologies]] 提供更完整的 drone EMC / EME test proposal 脈絡，但仍屬 Market 類簡報，缺 formal date / version。
- [[UAV signaling test solution]] 聚焦 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 [[LTE]]、[[5G]]、[[Wi-Fi]] 的 signaling test 與 De-sense validation；本來源則聚焦 EMC / EME / immunity / emissions / system-level RF environment，兩者互補但不可互相替代。
- [[UAV 通訊]] 記錄 C2、telemetry、payload data、SATCOM、4G/5G、Wi‑Fi、mesh 與 MAVLink / RTPS 等通訊議題；本來源補充通訊設備、GPS、mobile radio、broadcast emissions、data communications 與 power supply 可能形成 electromagnetic environment 的測試背景。
- [[Counter-UAV 技術]] 討論 detection / neutralization；本來源只在 customised solution 中列 [[CUAS System Performance Verification]]，沒有提供 counter-UAS system 的技術分類、產品或效能數字。
- [[UAV 系統方塊圖]] 整理 UAV 子系統；本來源補充 drone components 如 battery、BMS、ESC、FCM、CM、antennas 與 sensors，但未提供 specific architecture 或 BOM。

2025RS Drone Solution › 重點摘要
- 本來源是由 `2025RS Drone Solution.pdf` 轉出的 lossy markdown，標題為 `DRONE TEST SOLUTION PROPOSAL`；來源檔名含 `2025RS`，但正文未標示正式發布日期、作者、版本或簡報完整封面。
- 來源以 [[EMC]] / [[EME]] 為主軸，說明 drone / [[UAV]] / [[UAS]] 在 residential、outdoor AUT、MIL battle environment 與 multi-domain operations 下會遭遇不同電磁干擾與測試需求。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 與既有知識的關係
- 與 [[R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft]]、[[R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu]] 同屬 2026-02-26 R&S battle card 類型來源；三者都應視為競品銷售定位，而不是正式規格來源。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 的正式規格仍需以 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]（Version 11.00，August 2025）與 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]（Version 32，CSW 9.20.0 and higher）追溯。
- 本來源提到 [[R&S CMW500]] covers all legacy + EN-DC；[[R&S CMW500]] 的正式資料需追溯 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]]。
- 本來源新增 [[Keysight]] 在 wireless device testing battle card 語境中的公司與 UXM portfolio 描述；既有 [[Keysight]] 頁主要來自高頻高速 PCB 測試圖像來源，兩者資料層次不同。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 對 Keysight 的主要主張
| 主題 | 來源對 Keysight 的說法 | 限制 |
|---|---|---|
| Portfolio | UXM 5G Wireless Test Platforms E7515B/W/P/E/R、ProbSim、Nemo、RaySim、Atlas、C-V2X、cybersecurity tools | 未提供 Keysight 官方 datasheet 或版本 |
| Architecture | Multi-Box UXM approach；不同 UXM 有不同 NR bandwidth、RF ports、Rel-17 support、WLAN capability、IP throughput、FR2 readiness | 未列各 SKU 的完整規格條件 |
| Software model | Atlas + Channel Studio + RaySim + Nemo + WLAN tools + UXM-specific features；no unified automation environment | 這是 R&S battle card 觀點，需 Keysight 官方資料驗證 |
| Support model | tiered KeysightCare model：Assured、Enhanced、Application Software Support；optional warranty / calibration assurance plan | 未提供 KeysightCare 文件版次或服務條款 |
| Wi-Fi | Wi-Fi signaling only on selected models：E7515W、E7515P | 未提供 Keysight WLAN option / configuration 文件 |
| RedCap | E7515R is dedicated RedCap / IoT model | 未提供 E7515R 官方規格或 order data |
| FR3 / 6G | UXM-P bandwidth options + RaySim + future hardware / software；multi-component approach | future hardware / software 未標示日期、型號或 release status |

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › R&S / Rohde & Schwarz 相關
- [[R&S CMX500]] — battle card 的核心產品；來源定位為 one-platform cellular + Wi-Fi + fading + IP + NTN + RedCap 測試平台。
- [[R&S CMW500]] — 來源在 Keysight weaknesses 中說 R&S CMW500 covers all legacy + EN-DC；正式能力需追溯 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]]。
- [[RFU18]] — 來源描述為 wide frequency range up to 18 GHz，並說 max aggregated NR bandwidth 2000 MHz with RFU18；來源未提供正式 order number、specification document、release date 或 configuration 條件。
- [[CMsquares]]、[[R&S CMsequencer]]、[[CONTEST]]、[[AI Script Assistant]] — battle card 中 R&S unified automation / software ecosystem 的列名。
- [[TS8980]]、[[TS-RRM]] — 來源在 NR-NTN conformance 敘述中與 CMX500、CONTEST 同列。
- [[Samsung]] — 來源說 R&S was first to validate 3GPP NR-NTN conformance across RF、RRM、PCT with Samsung。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › Battle card 中的 R&S positioning
來源的 positioning statement 主張：

- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] delivers the industry’s only fully integrated platform for FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi、fading、IP throughput、RF analysis、NTN、RedCap and end-to-end signalling in one instrument。
- 來源說 [[Keysight]] spreads equivalent capabilities across multiple UXM models、add-on software and external tools。
- 來源說 R&S ensures long-term scalability、measurement accuracy and path from R&D to certification without hardware fragmentation。

使用限制：以上是 sales language；其中 only、industry’s only、fully integrated、long-term scalability、lower TCO 等敘述不能當作可驗證規格，需回查正式 datasheet、features document、conformance report 或配置工具。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › Keysight 相關
- [[Keysight]] — 本 battle card 的競品公司。
- [[Keysight UXM]] — 來源中的 UXM 5G Wireless Test Platforms 總稱。
- [[Keysight E7515P]] — 來源稱 high-end wideband / 5G platform with Wi-Fi as additional capability；quick table 稱 E7515P up to 15 GHz。
- [[Keysight E7515W]] — 來源稱 Wi-Fi 7 / connectivity platform。
- [[Keysight E7515B]] — 來源稱 standard / mid-tier 5G UXM。
- [[Keysight E7515E]] — 來源稱 value / mid-tier 5G UXM。
- [[Keysight E7515R]] — 來源稱 RedCap / IoT-only SKU。
- [[ProbSim]] — channel emulator；來源在 integrated vs external fading landmine 中列名。
- [[RaySim]] — digital twin / ray tracing engine；來源說 advanced fading、digital twin、FR3 / 6G scenarios 可能需要 RaySim。
- [[Channel Studio]] — channel modeling / fading 相關 external tool。
- [[Nemo]] — field test tools；來源列於 Keysight fragmented toolchain。
- [[Atlas]] — AI-powered device test / test management；來源列於 Keysight fragmented toolchain。
- [[KeysightCare]] — 來源說 Keysight support model 使用 tiered KeysightCare：Assured、Enhanced、Application Software Support，以及 optional warranty / calibration assurance plan。

RF pre-conformance testing › 與 strict conformance testing 的差異
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]：

- Application note procedures 可能相較 [[3GPP]] specification 更 streamlined 或 simplified。
- Pre-conformance testing 目標是在基於 [[3GPP]] specification 的 streamlined procedure 中提供 meaningful results，但不嚴格遵循所有 parameters。
- 嚴格的 RF conformance testing 與 validated test cases 可使用 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。

因此本概念頁不可把 [[R&S CMX500]] WebGUI pre-conformance workflow 等同正式 certification lab 或 validated conformance test cases。

RF pre-conformance testing › unresolved
- 來源未提供 RF pre-conformance testing 的一般性標準定義；本頁只根據 R&S 1C111 Version 1e 的 usage 建立。
- 來源未提供 formal certification body、lab accreditation 或 GCF / PTCRB procedure。
- 來源未提供所有 RF pre-conformance test cases 的完整 test matrix。

R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform › TS8980PRE-3 / TS8980PRE-3A / TS8980PRE-M1
- [[R&S TS8980PRE]]-3 test system 用於 pre-conformance R&D environment 的 design test 與 verification。
- `R&S TS8980PRE-3 (TS8980)` 的重要設計目標是相較 final conformance tests 達到良好 measurement accuracy 與高 confidence level。
- `R&S TS8980PRE-3 (TS8980)` 與 `R&S TS8980FTA-3 (TS8980)` RF conformance test system 共用許多但非全部 hardware components，因此來源稱兩系統的 test results 通常可預期非常接近。
- PRE 與 FTA 的主要硬體差異包括：PRE 的 frequency reference 一律為 [[R&S CMW500]]，不可連接 rubidium standard；PRE 使用 [[R&S SSCU3PA-1]] 與 [[R&S SSCU3PB-1]]；single rack 最多 2 台 [[R&S CMW500]]。
- `R&S TS-CMX-2RF2IF-ATS800R-4R (TS8980PRE-M1)` 是無 signal conditioning unit + [[R&S CMX500]] + [[R&S ATS800R]] 的 setup example。

R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform › 與 pre-conformance workflow 的區分
[[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 明示其 [[R&S CMX500]] pre-conformance procedure 可能相較 [[3GPP]] specification 更 streamlined 或 simplified，並且不嚴格遵循所有 parameters。該 application note 中的 [[R&S CMX500]] WebGUI workflow 適合 early-stage validation、debugging 與 step-by-step verification；strict RF conformance testing 與 validated test cases 則被來源另行指向 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。

[[RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63]] 補充：[[R&S TS8980PRE]] 是 pre-conformance test system series，用於 R&D environment 的 design test 與 verification；這是 system-family 層級，不等同於 1C111 的單一 CMX500 WebGUI workflow。

Short answer: In an Aerospace / Defense radar workflow, the passages do **not** support using a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester as the radar test instrument; it would fit only in the **wireless communications portion** of the workflow, such as LTE / 5G / WLAN link, OTA, RF, application, pre-conformance, or non-signaling RF validation around the platform or payload. [1][4][52]
- A signaling tester such as R&S CMX500 is positioned as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement solution for device testing across LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD. [1]
- In callbox use, CMX500 is used to quickly establish a DUT connection and run RF, mobility, application, NTN, WLAN / cellular desense, pre-conformance and non-signaling R&D verification. [4]
- The CMX500 callbox workflow explicitly includes Go-NoGo Testing, Non-Sig Testing, Conformance Testing and R&D Testing as test-phase context. [65]
- For signaling workflow, CMX500 provides NR FR1 / FR2 signaling, LTE signaling, NB-IoT / NB-NTN signaling, WLAN signaling and related TX measurements. [1]
- For non-signaling workflow, CMX500 GPRF Generator is described as a non-signaling use case that generates ARB, CW, dual tone or replay `.wv` waveforms for R&D waveform replay / creation and standalone TX measurement workflows. [54]
- For OTA communications testing, CMX500 OBT can be integrated with MVG WaveStudio and MVG antenna / multi-probe measurement systems to run 5G NR, RedCap, LTE and WLAN OTA signaling tests. [87]
- For radar-specific testing, the passages only identify R&S AREG800A as an Automotive Radar Echo Generator with dynamic artificial object generation, not as an Aerospace / Defense radar tester. [36]
- For Aerospace / Defense drone / UAV EMC and EME workflows, the cited solution focuses on EMI, EMS, EME, radiated / conducted layout and system-level effects testing, not cellular / WLAN protocol testing. [48]
- The same drone solution lists standard systems such as R&S TS9975 EMI Test System and R&S TS9982 EMS Test System for UAV / UAS drone T&M, but it does not map CMX500 to radar testing. [50]
- 【推論】Place the Signaling / Non-signaling Tester after or alongside radar/EME/EMC testing when the A&D system also needs LTE / 5G / WLAN connectivity validation, because CMX500 covers signaling and non-signaling communications tests while the A&D drone sources separate EMC / EME testing from signaling testing. [1][48][54]
- 【推論】Do not position CMX500 as the primary radar target/echo instrument from these passages; radar echo generation is only supported here for AREG800A in an automotive radar context, while CMX500 is supported for communications signaling and non-signaling RF workflows. [1][36][54]

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 [[R&S AREG800A]] Automotive Radar Echo Generator 的 specifications，文件編號 `PD 3609.8015.22`，文件版本 `Version 09.00`，文件日期 `September 2025（LA）`，文件標題為 `AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator`，Copyright `© 2021–2025 Rohde & Schwarz`。

[[R&S AREG800A]] 的 echo generator type 為 `dynamic artificial object generation`。Echo generation concept 分為：

- `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
- `digital`：針對 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 `air gap value`；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

產品資料適用條件（Version 09.00, September 2025）：

- 在環境溫度下儲存 3 小時後，進行 30 分鐘 warm-up operation。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格資料定義：

- `Specifications with limits`：代表保證的產品效能，以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、minimum 等限制符號表示。
- `Non-traceable specifications with limits (n. trc.)`：依 specifications with limits 的方式指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- `Specifications without limits`：代表保證的產品效能，通常為 dimensions 或 setting parameter resolution 等無偏差或偏差可忽略的值。
- `Typical data (typ.)`、`Nominal values (nom.)`、`Measured values (meas.)` 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- `Uncertainties`：coverage factor 為 2，依據 GUM 計算，納入 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- `Data without tolerance limits is not binding`；文件 `subject to change`。

主要能力與限制：

UAV UAS Drones T&M Solutions › 與 signaling test 的區分
- [[UAV signaling test solution]] 依 [[Signaling test solution]] 聚焦 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 UAV [[LTE]]、[[5G]]、[[Wi-Fi]] UE 的 signaling test 與 De-sense validation。
- [[UAV UAS Drones T&M Solutions]] 依 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 聚焦 [[EMC]]、[[EMI]]、[[EMS]]、[[EME]]、radiated / conducted layout 與 system-level effects test。

兩者可同屬 drone test solution 線索，但不可把 CMX500 signaling option 自動推論為 EMC / EME test system，也不可把 EMC 系統推論為 cellular / WLAN protocol tester。

UAV UAS Drones T&M Solutions › 來源中的 standard system
[[2025RS Drone Solution]] 的 `UAV/UAS Drones T&M Solutions` 頁列出 standard system：

| 來源列名 | 來源描述 | 使用限制 |
|---|---|---|
| [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]] | EMI Test System | 未提供完整規格、frequency range、receiver、antenna、software、chamber、order number 或適用標準。 |
| [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] | EMS Test System | 未提供 RF amplifier、field probe、immunity standard、software、chamber、frequency range 或 order number。 |
| [[R&S TS8997]] | 只見 `TS8997` | markdown 排版無法確認完整產品名稱、系統功能或與 EMI / EMS 的關係。 |

來源同頁還列出 `EMC Conformance`、`Commercial Drones`、`Military Drones` 與 `E-VTOL`，但沒有把每個測試系統與每個應用類別建立明確 mapping。

CMX500_Callbox › 重點摘要
- 來源 frontmatter 顯示原始檔為 `CMX500_Callbox.pptx`，由 markitdown 轉出，converted date 為 2026-09-17；投影片中另出現日期 **05.01.2026**，但日期格式未標示。
- 簡報將測試階段分為 [[Go-NoGo Testing]]、[[Non-Sig Testing]]、[[Conformance Testing]] 與 [[R&D Testing]]，並以 [[R&S CMX500]] callbox 作為可快速建立 call、進行 RF testing、mobility testing 與 application testing 的平台。
- Callbox focus 包含 [[RF Testing]]、[[3GPP pre-conformance]]、[[Mobility Testing]]、[[Application Testing]]、[[Network Slicing]]、[[IP Throughput]]、[[Security Analysis]]、[[Backend Service]]、[[IMS Services]]、[[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]、[[ATSSS]]、[[Power Consumption]]、[[XR Responsiveness & L4S]]、[[eCall]] / [[NGeCall]] 與 [[Speech Quality]]。
- 來源描述 [[CMsquares]] 為 web based、all-in-one configuration、all tools in one place、modern UI 的介面，並列出 live views、app testing、NTN live views、sequencer、log analysis 與 one-click RF testing。
- [[RF SA Preconformance]] 部分宣稱可在 GUI 中快速開始 manual 3GPP RF pre-conformance，並提到 automatic configuration of parameters per TC、25 TCs、dynamic workspace per TC、NR-NTN / NSA / LTE coming、release 時有 comprehensive App Note，連結為 `https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/appnote/1C111`。
- [[CMSequencer]] 部分描述可由 manual 快速切換到 automated pre-conformance，使用 same technology specific license，並引用 `Sequencer-CMX-Test_Packages_Database.xlsx`；來源圖表列出 RF pre-conformance TC count：category 7.1 為 3GPP 43、7.4 為 68、7.6 為 134、8.3 為 3GPP 159 / RED 33 / WiFi 92。
- R&D automation / RF pathloss calibration 部分描述 predefined blocks、mix & match、PL from signaling measurements + reports、GPRF measurements 與 NRP Power Meter；來源 notes 稱 NRP slightly more precise、GPRF 會包含 connector + additional RF path、golden device 最容易但 least precise。

CMX500 GPRF Generator
[[CMX500 GPRF Generator]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中的 [[R&S CMX500]] non-signaling use case：在 CMX500 上產生 ARB、CW、dual tone 或 replay `.wv` waveform，支援 R&D waveform replay / creation 與 standalone TX measurement 工作流。

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

MVG CMX500 OBT OTA signaling testing
[[MVG CMX500 OBT OTA signaling testing]] 是 [[MVG]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 新聞稿中描述的整合測試情境：將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 整合進 [[MVG]] 的 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]，讓 [[MVG]] antenna / multiprobe measurement systems 可直接執行 [[5G NR]]、[[RedCap]]、[[LTE]] 與 [[WLAN]] OTA signaling tests。[[MVG OTA test systems now support full WLAN OTA signaling testing alongside cellular coverage with CMX500 OBT from Rohde & Schwarz]] 將此情境擴充到 full [[WLAN]] signaling test functionality including [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]。
